name: W1051 - Web - File Transfer Services Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Web upload into the Unauthorized File Transfer Services surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before uploading to non-sanctioned file-sharing services. Exclusions: excludes domains in Websites_Authorized_File_Transfer_Services_Domains_[is]; tune by adding approved file-transfer tools (WeTransfer Pro, Aspera, Tresorit, etc.) to the Authorized list so legitimate transfers go through without warnings.
